expected: Patch full name and bio fields

name: Sharing

expected: Edit comment and delete reply

expected: Initiate 1:1 direct conversation between User A and User B

expected: Upload profile avatar image to static storage

expected: Update user theme preference (light/dark/system)

expected: Nonexistent entities return HTTP 404 cleanly

expected: Tampered or missing JWT returns HTTP 401 Unauthorized

name: Database Persistence

name: Browser Console

name: Production Build
expected: Vite production compilation succeeds
